footer.description: Free and open-source tools for financial calculations. Make more informed decisions about financing, consortium, and investments.

financiamento.title: Financing Calculator
financiamento.description: Simulate your financing using SAC or PRICE systems. View the complete amortization schedule with all installments.
financiamento.priceExplanation: Amortization system with fixed installments. Interest is higher at the beginning and decreases over time, while amortization increases.
financiamento.sacExplanation: Constant Amortization System. Amortization is fixed and installments decrease over time, as interest is calculated on the decreasing outstanding balance.

consorcio.title: Consortium Calculator
consorcio.description: Simulate your consortium installments with annual INCC/IPCA correction.

comparativo.title: Financing vs Consortium
comparativo.description: Compare financing and consortium side by side. See which option leaves more money in your pocket.

alugar-vs-comprar.title: Rent vs Buy
alugar-vs-comprar.description: Compare whether it's better to buy a financed property or rent and invest the difference.

tir.title: IRR Calculator
tir.description: Calculate the Internal Rate of Return of a series of cash flows.

juros-compostos.title: Compound Interest
juros-compostos.description: Calculate the yield of your investments with compound interest over time.
